extracted.name: Easy Corn Salad — Great Side for BBQs
extracted.description: Easy salads for BBQs are sometimes hard to find, but this corn salad with chile peppers, bell pepper, red onion, cucumber, and cilantro is a keeper!
ingredient_lines: 2 (10 ounce) cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers (such as RO*TEL®)
1 (15.25 ounce) can yellow and white corn, drained
2 (11 ounce) cans white corn with chipotle peppers
1 large seedless cucumber, peeled and diced
0.25 cup diced red onion, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Mix diced tomatoes with chile peppers, all corn, cucumber, bell peppers, cilantro, red onion, and lime juice together in a large bowl.
